claims.title: Physical Retention in Cold Memory is 100%
claims.statement: Both A_long (t=100) and A_mid (t=2000) are physically retained in Cold Memory at T=3000 across all canonical seeds.
claims.evidence: Both A_long and A_mid confirmed present in cold memory across seeds [101, 202, 303].

claims.title: Cold Memory Stage 1 Pre-Filter Truncation
claims.statement: Inside Cold Memory, raw cosine similarity ranks both A_long and A_mid within the Top 10 across all seeds, so Stage 1 pre-filter (k=50 or 100) does NOT drop them.
claims.evidence: A_long pass rate at k=50: 100.0%, A_mid pass rate: 100.0%. (Cold Memory subspace clustering filters out raw distractors).

claims.title: Temporal Decay Recency Bonus for Recent Distractors
claims.statement: Exponential temporal decay awards late distractors (delta_t < 100) an unearned +0.15~0.20 score bonus over ancient causal roots (delta_t ~ 2900).
claims.evidence: Observed mean temporal score advantage: +0.1540 (Raw temp_compat: ~0.98 vs ~0.20, weighted by w_temp=0.20).

claims.title: Recurrent State Auto-correlation with Recent Events
claims.statement: The recurrent hidden state h_t strongly auto-correlates with recent inputs, awarding late background distractors an unearned +0.20~0.30 state score bonus.
claims.evidence: Observed mean state score advantage for late distractors: +0.2259 (Raw state_compat: ~0.99 vs ~0.24, weighted by w_state=0.30).

claims.title: B4 Full Store Oracle Fails under RevisionEngine
claims.statement: Even with an unbounded 3000-event full memory store, RevisionEngine achieves 0.0% recall and 100% FRR, proving the failure is ranking bias, not memory capacity.
claims.evidence: B4 with RevisionEngine: Recall=0.0%, FRR=100.0%, A_long mean rank=1189.7. In contrast, B4 with Sim-Only achieves 100.0% recall.

claims.title: Vectorized Revision Engine Parity & Sub-100us Latency
claims.statement: Vectorized PyTorch batch scoring achieves exact numerical parity (<1e-5 error) and reduces query latency below 100 us (achieving >200x speedup over Python loop).
claims.evidence: Max numerical diff: 2.98e-08, Query latency: 18.61 us (Speedup: 321.3x vs 5978.0 us).
